text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "It is possible to gain access to official SFOE documents under the Freedom of Information Act.", "gist": "Access to SFOE official documents is allowed under the Freedom of Information Act."}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "This applies to documents produced after 1 July 2006.", "gist": "The rule applies only to documents created on or after 1 July 2006."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "There is no complicated procedure for requesting access – a written request is not required.", "gist": "No complex procedure or written request is needed to request access."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "You just need to provide enough information for us to identify the document requested.", "gist": "Requesters must supply sufficient details to identify the document."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Give as much information as possible: the date the document was created, the title or references, the exact subject domain and the time period it refers to are all useful.", "gist": "Providing details like creation date, title, subject, and time period helps identify the document."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SFOE", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE)"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "The SFOE may ask you to provide greater precision if your request is not detailed enough or if you are asking for multiple documents.", "gist": "SFOE can request more details if the initial request is unclear or covers multiple documents."}]}
